authority_decision.file_history: hg.history.StateStore remains legacy V1 file-backed chronological/event projection store for the current PhoneRuntime. It is not made authorization-capable by adding a structural classifier.
authority_decision.canonical_contract: hg.contracts defines strict HG_EVENT_V1 events with sequence/runtime/state-owner metadata, actor, authority, idempotency, evidence refs and record digest.
authority_decision.authorized_mutation_backend: hg.sqlite_state.SQLiteStateStore validates/consumes policy MutationPermit and atomically commits event+projection+outbox in SQLite transactions.
authority_decision.policy: hg.policy issues single-use in-process permits bound to exact mutation payload/action/correlation/idempotency/authority. These permits are not serializable durable credentials.
authority_decision.v2_branch_conflict: circulatory hg/history.py writes HG_HISTORY_EVENT_V2 into file-backed log and uses MUTATION_EVENT_ACTIONS and MutationPermit; merging it directly with SQLiteStateStore authority path would create duplicate authority semantics unless a migration/API decision is specified.
authority_decision.chosen_for_this_slice: Add history_record_contract(record), a read-only structural V1/V2 classifier; do not append V2 or consume MutationPermit through legacy StateStore. Preserve event schema variants and data.
authority_decision.restoration: All 7 distinct source hashes remain preserved in docs/consolidation/source-branches; no source refs deleted.

known_debt: The read-only classifier confirms structural shape only. It does not verify a V2 record hash/schema/sequence chain as a full V2 reader would.
File-backed hg.history.StateStore still has ResourceWarning file reads and lacks process-wide lock/atomic writes from the strict source branch. These are not silently claimed integrated.

A formal migration adapter from file-history V1 to canonical HG_EVENT_V1 SQLiteStateStore remains unimplemented because source data mapping, cursor/projection restore semantics and authority changes must be defined and tested.
